newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks gain six pct on positive sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks gain six pct on positive sentiment.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed six percent higher on positive sentiment after the news that four executives of the Beximco group of companies, accused of stock price manipulation, won a court order staying proceedings of cases against them, brokers said.
Brokers said the executives of Beximco Pharmaceuticals and Shine Pukur Holdings obtained a stay order on the proceeding of the cases by a Dhaka court.
Bangladesh's Securities Exchange Commission last month filed cases against 36 brokers and firms for price manipulation that caused turmoil in the market late last year.
The Beximco group of companies accounts for more than 27 percent of total market capitalization.
Most of the shares of the Beximco group rose by about 10 percent on Sunday. One broker said the price could rise more if there was no cap on price fluctuation.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index rose 59.14 points or 6.04 percent at 1,037.21 on a turnover of 41.3 million taka on Sunday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh. Beximco Fisheries rose 18.18 taka to 203, Beximco pharmaceuticals gained 8.27 to 121.79 and Singer Bangladesh was up 475 to 6,057.
